stories.title: Dates for the diary: 2026/27 league calendar announced
stories.summary: The countdown to a new season is on. Tchoukball UK has published five National League rounds and four South-East Regional League rounds, giving Rhinos players and supporters dates to put in the diary through April 2027.
body: November brings a busy start to the league season, with National League rounds in Luton on 8 and 22 November before the South-East Regional League gets under way in Southsea on 29 November. With the calendar now published, Rhinos players and supporters can start planning for the months ahead.
All five National League rounds are scheduled for Venue 360, The Riverside, 20 Gipsy Lane, Luton, LU1 3JH.

National League dates
Round 1: Sunday 8 November 2026
Round 2: Sunday 22 November 2026
Round 3: Sunday 17 January 2027
Round 4: Sunday 7 February 2027
Round 5: Sunday 11 April 2027

The South-East Regional League calendar includes two rounds at Fareham Academy, giving the club two league dates right on our doorstep. The opening and final rounds are scheduled for Portsmouth High School.

South-East Regional League dates
Round 1: Sunday 29 November 2026, Portsmouth High School
Round 2: Sunday 10 January 2027, Fareham Academy
Round 3: Sunday 14 February 2027, Fareham Academy
Round 4: Sunday 7 March 2027, Portsmouth High School

Regional venues
Portsmouth High School: 25 Kent Road, Southsea, PO5 3EQ.
Fareham Academy: St Anne’s Grove, Fareham, PO14 1JJ.

Also on the wider TUK calendar, Team UK training takes place at Venue 360 on Sunday 6 December 2026. The men’s session runs from 12–3pm, followed by the women’s and M40 session from 3–6pm. These are Team UK sessions, separate from regular Rhinos club training.

These are published league round dates rather than individual Rhinos match fixtures. Opponents and match times are still to be confirmed. Players should keep an eye on Spond for club arrangements and check the official Tchoukball UK calendar for any changes.
New season, familiar faces and plenty of tchoukball ahead. Get the dates in your diary and let’s get behind the Rhinos!

stories.title: Fareham Rhinos stars help Team UK claim European silver in Switzerland
stories.summary: Fareham Rhinos were strongly represented at Euro 26 in Magglingen/Macolin, Switzerland, with Rhinos players representing Tchoukball UK across the senior and youth competitions — and bringing European silverware back to Fareham.
body: Fareham Rhinos players enjoyed a memorable European Championships as members of the Tchoukball UK squads competing at Euro 26 in Magglingen/Macolin, Switzerland.

The club had a particularly strong presence in the Men's Over-40 squad, with eight Rhinos — Lyall Cairns, David Going, Richard Jackson, Ashley Johnson, Jason Longhurst, Chris Sherwood, Nigel Twiddy and Andrew Wolfe — representing the UK alongside Rhinos coach Clifford Jenner.

The UK Over-40s produced an excellent 46–33 victory over France before meeting Italy in a dramatic final. Just two points separated the teams at the finish, with Italy taking the title 53–51 and the UK securing the European silver medal.

The next generation of Rhinos was represented too, with Samuel Collinson, Lucas Hook, Joshua Johnson, Jelena Jones and Lucy Kirkby involved at youth level. The UK M18 girls also returned home with European silver.
It was another proud chapter for Fareham Rhinos, showing the pathway that exists from regular club training in Fareham through to representing Tchoukball UK on the international stage.

stories.title: Leeds and Fareham combine for unbeaten National League Cup win
stories.summary: Fareham Rhinos joined forces with Leeds for a one-off combined side at the National League Cup in Luton — and Leeds Rhinos went through the day unbeaten to win the tournament.
body: Fareham Rhinos joined forces with players from Leeds on Sunday for a memorable day at Tchoukball UK's National League Cup in Luton, with the one-off combined side going unbeaten and winning the tournament.
The development competition was held at Venue 360 – The Riverside and provided an opportunity for players to get back on court at the start of the new domestic season.
For the day, Josh, James, Sam, Jacko and Lewis represented Fareham alongside Leeds players Dan and Nick, competing together under the Leeds Rhinos name.
The combination proved a successful one. Leeds Rhinos went through the tournament unbeaten and finished the day as National League Cup winners.
Fareham's involvement extended beyond the winning team. Dave assisted the UK Women's side taking part in the competition, which also featured Rhinos players Jelena and Luce.

It was a fantastic day of tchoukball and a real pleasure to join forces with Leeds for the tournament. A huge thank you to them for teaming up with us — hopefully we'll have the chance to play alongside them again soon.
